CustomField.description: P&P Unit Price before partner discount (includes other discount such as volume, term, additional discount)
CustomField.formula:
/*IF( PartnerDiscount_2__c <> 0, SBQQ__NetPrice__c ,SBQQ__NetPrice__c/(1-PartnerDiscount_2__c))*/
IF( AND( SBQQ__Quote__r.Business_Motion_Oppty__c <> 'MSP', TEXT(Product_Group__c) = 'Software', !SBQQ__Bundle__c), Round( Net_Unit_Price__c / Percent_to_Decimal__c,2), SBQQ__CustomerPrice__c )
CustomField.label: *Customer Unit Price
